items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: That's the first place I ever met Billie Holiday.

ctx.x: Gee. That was -- yeah. There wasn't any mixing on bandstands, right?

Oh, no. Not in public. There was plenty of it went on in sessions. I mean all the guys used to get together and not only in L.A., but in New York and Chicago and every other place. There'd always be a session going someplace. Particularly I remember up in -- this was a little later on, a couple of years later, but we always used to go up to the Alexander Bar and Grill, on the corner of 7th Avenue and 126th Street, up in Harlem, and they had a back room there.
